blocks.text: Quality sound just got easier—and more fun. JBL Vibe Beam 2 earbuds feature exciting JBL Pure Bass Sound, plus Active Noise Cancelling and Smart Ambient technology so you decide how much of the outside world you want to hear. Manage hands-free crisp, clear calls with just a tap on the earbuds. Use the JBL Headphones app to customize your sound and Voice Prompts language. Connect seamlessly with up to 8 Bluetooth® devices and switch effortlessly from one to another. And with up to 40 hours* of playback time, they’re a great everyday sound companion. (*with ANC off)

items.label: JBL Pure Bass sound
items.value: JBL Vibe Beam 2 earbuds feature 8mm dynamic drivers that deliver exciting JBL Pure Bass sound.

items.label: Active Noise Cancelling
items.value: Listen to your surroundings & filter out distracting noise. Smart Ambient lets you control how much of the outside world you want to hear, so you can talk with others or stay aware of your surroundings while keeping your earbuds in

items.label: 4 mics for crisp, clear calls
items.value: Two mics on each earbud pick up and clearly transmit your voice while canceling out ambient noise. So you can make clear, crisp calls even when you're walking through a busy park on a breezy day.

items.label: 40 total hours of playback
items.value: Enjoy 10 hours of playtime, plus another three full charges (30Hrs) in the charging case.* Need to recharge even faster? 10 minutes on a USB type-C charging cable will give you another three hours of playtime. (*with ANC off)

items.label: JBL Headphones app
items.value: Select the EQ that fits your style or customize your own. Voice Prompts in multiple languages give you useful information (e.g.if battery is running low). Or chill out and recharge in Relax Mode by choosing one of five peaceful sounds.

items.label: Built-in Media
items.value: 1 x 3 sizes of ear tips, 1 x Charging case, 1 x JBL Vibe Beam 2 headphones, 1 x Type-C USB charging cable, User Manual

items.label: Antenna Location
items.value: Audio Monitoring, Calling, Exercising, Gaming, Office Meetings

items.label: Compatible Devices
items.value: Cellphones, Desktops, Gaming Consoles, Laptops, Tablets
